understood_as: Audit the fixed entire first Bb system and render only existing source-confirmed content, with explicit gaps rather than invented or silently omitted source notation.
source_note_confirmation_scope: Only printed measure 3 from the actual GT12 owner confirmation
rendering_policy: Keep full original staff polylines and frozen physical measure candidates. Reuse exact GT12 m3 music/chord/lyric masks. Leave all other musical content as labeled gaps. No newly inferred lyrics/chords or source-pixel composition.
unsupported_header: Clef/key glyph placement, time-signature and forward-repeat engraving have no validated renderer contract; use explicit missing-context label, not substitute glyphs.
geometry_policy: Retain GT12/GT02 physical boundary candidates; report the separate 0-1px OMR-boundary disagreement without correcting it.
visual_review: Freeze actual PNGs first, then agent inspection; neither source candidates nor visual review are independent human truth.
